transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, doctor... I guess what brought me in is that I lost my temper the other day. I blew up at one of the younger volunteers, just over a crooked tablecloth. I... I don't usually talk to people that way. It really bothered me that I acted like that.
Has losing your temper like that happened before, or is this something completely new for you?
No, it's completely new. I haven't been like this before. It's really just been going on for about a week now... ever since that robbery outside the bank.
Since the robbery, have you been having unwanted memories, flashbacks, or nightmares about what happened?

Yes, I have. It's... well, it happens out of nowhere, really. I'll just be sitting quietly at my kitchen table, and suddenly I hear that man's rough voice right in my head. Or I'll see the donation envelope hitting the ground again. It just pops up like that, even when I'm not trying to think about it at all.
Have you found yourself going out of your way to avoid places, people, or situations that remind you of the robbery?

Yes, I have. I've actually been taking the long way around town lately just so I don't have to pass by that bank. And... well, I haven't gone into the festival storage room either. Being in there just brings the whole thing a bit too close for comfort. It's just easier to stay away.
Could you tell me exactly when the robbery took place?
Well, like I mentioned a little bit ago, it was about a week ago. That's when the robbery happened, right outside the bank.
Since the robbery, have you found yourself feeling constantly on guard or on high alert for danger?

No, I wouldn't really say so. I mean... I'm not walking around looking over my shoulder all the time, or feeling like something bad is about to jump out at me. Aside from just staying away from the bank like I said, I feel perfectly safe sitting in my own house or just going about my normal business. I haven't really noticed feeling on edge like that.
Since the robbery, have you felt detached from yourself, or felt like the world around you is unreal or dreamlike?
No, I can't say I've felt anything like that. I know who I am, and everything feels real enough to me. I haven't had any moments where things felt like a dream or like I was detached from myself.
